title: Edera's Object Capability Bounded Authority Promises to Isolate Credentials From AI Agent Workloads
gist: Edera launched Object Capability Bounded Authority, a hypervisor-enforced object-capability model that lets AI agents and MCP servers perform narrowly scoped actions without ever holding credentials, via components like capcurl, capsudo and SPIFFE/SPIRE identity. Only scoped command execution and workload identity shipped initially; credential-brokered API access follows under Project Lunchbox.

insights.claim: Organizations deploying autonomous coding agents routinely expose API tokens, cloud keys and admin credentials to execution environments that remain vulnerable to prompt injection and supply chain manipulation.
